reason: Core functionality is solid and verified, but there are two critical issues to address before finalizing: excessive IO from heavy per-agent arrays and a purity violation in ObservationAggregator.forward. With 3 iterations remaining, a focused iteration can significantly improve performance, robustness, and design consistency without large refactors.

specific_areas: Add save_heavy_io (default False) and io_agent_sample_n parameters; drop or sample heavy arrays in module IO; keep aggregates
Make ObservationAggregator.forward pure; move all appends/smoothing/lagging into Simulation.run commit phase
Harden get_calibrator() by filtering kwargs against constructor signature and warning/falling back on invalid keys
Optimize InfluencePropagation._neighbor_social_fraction via caching/vectorization or smaller window for large N
Disambiguate 'never adopted' vs 'relapsed' using an ever_adopted flag or clear sentinel in BehaviorDecayAndMemory
Expose new IO controls in parameter definitions and CLI; apply flags in main()
Remove redundant pass statements and minor cleanup
Add basic performance guards (e.g., artifact size and runtime checks for N=2000, T=120) in CI configuration or a quick benchmark mode

task_understanding.adjustments: Prioritize performance and design purity fixes over new model features; maintain backward compatibility by gating changes behind new parameters.

data_analysis.adjustments: Add a simple benchmark plan: measure total artifact size and wall-clock time with N=2000, T=120 before and after changes; track key observables to ensure dynamics are unchanged aside from intended smoothing/lag relocation.

model_planning.adjustments: Defer advanced model improvements (EMA social memory, policy schedules) to a later iteration; plan minimal-scoped changes that do not alter core adoption dynamics except for the observables pipeline refactor.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement feature flags (save_heavy_io, io_agent_sample_n); refactor ObservationAggregator.forward to be side-effect-free; add ever_adopted handling; avoid broad rewrites; include clear inline comments and warnings.

code_verification.adjustments: Extend verification to check: absence of heavy arrays in IO when save_heavy_io=False; calibrator kwargs filtering (no TypeError on extra keys); consistency of observables series lengths and lag logic; optional micro tests for neighbor cache correctness.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run a performance sanity test with N=2000, T=120 and default flags to validate reduced IO; ensure runs complete quickly and artifacts are within acceptable size; verify CLI flags toggle behavior correctly.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Since real data is absent, add sanity checks: monotonicity of cumulative adoption, plausible ranges for rates, and invariance of dynamics pre/post refactor (except observables smoothing/lag relocation).

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide a concise change log and code diff summary focusing on the modified files/functions, highlight any backward-compatibility implications, and include guidance on using new IO flags.
